title: Friends, celebrations and fashion
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a barátaidról, az ünnepekről, a divatról és a vásárlásról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, és indokold, amit mondasz.

questions.q: Tell me about your best friend. How did you meet?
followUps: What do you like most about him or her?

questions.q: What do you and your friends usually do when you meet?
What makes a good friend, in your opinion?
Which family celebration do you like best? Why?
followUps: How does your family celebrate it?

questions.q: How did you celebrate your last birthday?
Do you get on well with older people, for example your neighbours or your friends' parents?
Is fashion important to you? What kind of clothes do you like wearing?
followUps: Where do you usually buy your clothes?

questions.q: Do you prefer shopping alone or with friends? Why?
What do teenagers in Hungary often argue about with their parents?

usefulPhrases.en: We've known each other since primary school.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Tell me about your best friend. How did you meet?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My best friend is called Bence. We met in our first year at secondary school, because we sat next to each other in maths. We soon found out that we both love football.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you like most about him?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: He's very reliable. If I have a problem, I know I can always count on him.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What makes a good friend, in your opinion?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think a good friend is honest and loyal. He or she listens to you and tells you the truth, even when it's not what you want to hear.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which family celebration do you like best? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I like Christmas best, because the whole family gets together at my grandparents' house in Kaposvár. We always eat fish soup and bejgli, which is a traditional Hungarian cake.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do teenagers in Hungary often argue about with their parents?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think the most common topics are screen time and going out in the evening. Parents often think we spend too much time on our phones, and they worry if we come home late.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó elmeséli a megismerkedést, jellemzi a barátját, véleményt mond és indokol, az utolsó, általánosabb kérdésre pedig két konkrét példát hoz – minden válasz érdemi.
Szókincs: a barátság és az ünnepek témakörének szavai változatosak (reliable, count on, honest and loyal, gets together, screen time).
Nyelvhelyesség: az egyszerű múlt (met, sat, found out) és a jelen egyszerű idő következetes, a „which is a traditional Hungarian cake” és az „even when …” mellékmondat helyes.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I know I can always count on him”, „even when it's not what you want to hear”, „the whole family gets together”, „I think the most common topics are …”.
